main.description: Projects one actor's indexed profile, organization and primary location by DID. Makes one best-effort handle lookup against the configured resolver; the handle is omitted when it fails. An empty projection is not proof that an account exists. Authentication is not required.

actor.description: DID of the actor to look up. Handles are not accepted.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An actor DID or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: ActorQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed profile, organization or primary location could not be queried.

actor.description: View of the requested DID, even when no sidecars are indexed. Includes a nullable location.
